text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It made me want to dash off and run myself... Well, more like it really warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...It made me want to cheer you on as well♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A bowl to recharge your energy—cheering ramen.
Please let me treat you to some♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...May I come observe again sometime?
Fufu, it really gives me so much energy♪
